plan1-supervisor-shipment-safety-h105-ro: 2026-08-10 cycle-3 review-fix. SUPERSEDES memory key 'plan1-supervisor-shipment-safety-task-only-manifests', whose task-only rule is WRONG and must not be applied. CORRECT RULE (hardening H10.5): a covering feature is safe to close iff BOTH (1) FULL COVERAGE - every descendant is in that same shipment's release scope, and (2) ROOT PLACEMENT - the feature has no parent feature. WHY: backlogit 1.8.0 gates setArtifactStatus(feature,done) and collectArchiveCandidateIDs on explicitScope (manifest membership, 133-F/133.004-T), BUT returnUnreleasedFeatureItems is NOT gated - it runs for EVERY feature returned by featureScopeRoots, member or not, and calls clearParentID on each out-of-scope descendant. So excluding the feature from the manifest disarms the archive cascade and ARMS the parent-clearing cascade. Task-only manifests are therefore NOT a safety measure when children span shipments; they orphan the downstream tasks instead (reproduced: 14/14 orphaned). Under full coverage, membership is strictly SAFER than non-membership: the engine marks the feature done and archives it with its own tasks, whereas a non-member feature is left permanently queued with all children done, requiring a manual post-close archive. TRAP: nesting per-shipment features under a shared parent satisfies (1) but breaks (2) - featureScopeRoots walks parent_id UPWARD transitively, so closing S1 would walk task->S1feature->umbrella and orphan every sibling shipment's tasks. Per-shipment covering features MUST stay root-level. Grouping is safe via related_to links because featureScopeRoots walks parent_id ONLY and does not traverse item_links. A childless umbrella is inert (descendantItems empty) and can be closed engine-natively as a member of the FINAL shipment, listed last so the real covering feature wins the covering_feature render projection. NEVER discharge a shipment-safety finding by prescribing a Ship-side adopt_item/post-close repair: adopt is not in Ship's enumerated Role Boundary (claim/move/close/archive), so fail-closed P-010 makes it forbidden, and it is not reliability-first. ALSO: AdoptItem rewrites parent_id/hierarchical IDs/filenames/dependencies/links but NOT shipment custom_fields.items, and backlogit 1.8.0 has NO remove-from-shipment op - manifests are effectively immutable, so fixing one requires create-new + archive-old with supersedes links. Proof pattern that worked: two-arm disposable-fixture simulation (control reproduces the defect, redesign shows returned_ids=[]) plus a fixture replay of the exact live topology. Assert on returned_ids, never on argument.
